name: panic-capture
description: Port of the debug-test panic-capture flow (`python3 tools/meson/gdb_run.py debug-test --arch x86_64 --build debug --class testrunner --gdb-script tools/gdb/test-batch.gdb`): QEMU owned by gdb_run.py debug-test; the GDB script breaks on panic, captures state, touches build/gdb-panic-captured and exits 1. gdb_run.py intentionally exits 1 on capture, so accept_exit [0,1] and the 'GDB PANIC CAPTURED' marker is the success oracle.
